boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Loyola University Chicago
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with publicly posted evening hours, spanning Loyola’s Lake Shore Campus and nearby North Side neighborhoods.

cards.title: MEDI at Damen Food Court
cards.subtitle: Damen Student Center, Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Use the campus dining page to check the current weekday schedule, then stop in before its posted 10 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A campus-based Mediterranean option with verified weekday evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Loyola Campus Dining lists MEDI at 6511 N. Sheridan Road and standard Monday–Friday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.source_title: MEDI — Loyola University Chicago Campus Dining
cards.access_notes: Posted standard hours are Monday–Friday, 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; check the campus dining page for exceptions.

cards.title: South of the Border on Morse
cards.subtitle: 1416 W. Morse Ave., Rogers Park
cards.notes: Confirm the menu and carryout option online, then plan pickup before the restaurant’s posted midnight close.
cards.short_summary: A Rogers Park restaurant with food and carryout posted through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: South of the Border posts business and carryout hours through midnight every day at 1416 W. Morse Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Business hours are posted as ending at midnight daily; carryout is also posted through midnight.

cards.title: Candlelite Chicago
cards.subtitle: 7452 N. Western Ave., Rogers Park
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s own ordering page to confirm the day, then allow time before the kitchen’s posted 1 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: Thin-crust pizza and burgers with kitchen service posted until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Candlelite Chicago posts kitchen hours until 1 a.m. daily at 7452 N. Western Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Kitchen hours are posted through 1:00 a.m. daily; delivery is posted through midnight.

cards.title: Wingstop on Clark Street
cards.subtitle: 7003 N. Clark St., Rogers Park
cards.notes: Check the location page before heading out and place a carryout or delivery order within the posted late-hours window.
cards.short_summary: A Rogers Park carryout and delivery option with 1 a.m. listed closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingstop’s Chicago location directory lists the Rogers Park location at 7003 N. Clark Street as closing at 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official Chicago location directory lists this site as closing at 1:00 a.m.; verify before travel.

cards.title: Gino’s North at Granville
cards.subtitle: 1111 W. Granville Ave., Edgewater
cards.notes: Order ahead or visit for the kitchen’s posted evening service; the restaurant lists food service through midnight daily.
cards.short_summary: An Edgewater Italian restaurant whose kitchen is listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Gino’s North lists its kitchen hours as 4 p.m.–midnight daily at 1111 W. Granville Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Kitchen hours are posted as 4:00 p.m.–midnight daily; confirm service availability before leaving.

cards.title: Tasty Sub on Howard
cards.subtitle: 2001 W. Howard St., Chicago
cards.notes: Use the live ordering listing to confirm pickup availability and arrive well before its currently listed late closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Howard Street pickup option with a currently listed 3 a.m. full-menu window.
cards.evidence_claim: Uber Eats lists Tasty Sub at 2001 W. Howard Street with a full menu available from 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The live ordering page lists the full menu until 3:00 a.m.; availability can change, so confirm before travel.

cards.title: Vicky’s on Clark
cards.subtitle: 6632 N. Clark St., Rogers Park
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s posted day-specific hours and use the menu or online-order link for a late evening food stop.
cards.short_summary: A Rogers Park restaurant with late Friday and Saturday service posted.
cards.evidence_claim: Vicky’s Restaurant posts Friday and Saturday hours from 10 a.m. to 12 a.m. at 6632 N. Clark Street.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday hours are posted until 12:00 a.m.; Sunday through Thursday are posted until 11:00 p.m.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies by Loyola Station
cards.subtitle: 6470 N. Sheridan Rd., Chicago
cards.notes: Verify the store’s current order window before going; the location is a documented bakery address immediately by Loyola Station.
cards.short_summary: A named cookie bakery location beside Loyola Station for an evening dessert stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Waze identifies Insomnia Cookies at 6470 N. Sheridan Road and lists daily hours extending to 3 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The live map lists closing at 3:00 a.m. daily; confirm directly with the store or ordering system before travel.

cards.title: Little Bad Wolf in Andersonville
cards.subtitle: 1541 W. Bryn Mawr Ave., Chicago
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s current service hours before leaving and choose food service rather than its bar-focused offerings.
cards.short_summary: A nearby restaurant destination appropriate for a food-focused evening plan.
cards.evidence_claim: Little Bad Wolf is a named restaurant in Chicago’s Andersonville neighborhood with a public business presence.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current kitchen hours directly with the restaurant before travel; no independently verified current late-hours detail was available.

cards.title: Paulie Gee’s in Damen Food Court
cards.subtitle: Damen Food Court, Lake Shore Campus
cards.notes: Check the food court’s live dining schedule before heading over, then use this on-campus pizza counter during posted service.
cards.short_summary: A named pizza counter inside Loyola’s Damen Food Court.
cards.evidence_claim: Established Chicago student-area coverage identifies Paulie Gee’s Loyola inside the Damen Food Court at 1125 W. Loyola Avenue and reports 11 a.m.–10 p.m. daily hours.
cards.source_title: Eater Chicago — Paulie Gee's Loyola opening
cards.access_notes: Reported hours extend to 10:00 p.m.; Loyola directs visitors to Campus Dish for the most current Damen Food Court hours.

warnings: Two cards rely on third-party live location/order listings or older local reporting rather than a first-party current-hours page. Their access notes explicitly direct users to verify hours before travel.
One complete board returned with exactly 10 distinct, under-21-safe place cards.
